split.short_tasks: Tasks with fewer than 50 examples contribute all available rows to calibration/validation and no rows beyond their length.

hypotheses.primary: The calibration-fitted conservative Bayesian reward router has higher exact-match accuracy than direct_answer on the untouched E2B test split.
hypotheses.secondary_novel_prompt: condition_reconstruction has higher exact-match accuracy than direct_answer on the untouched E2B test split.
hypotheses.secondary_transfer: The frozen E4B reward_routed_v2 policy transfers positively to E2B relative to direct_answer.
hypotheses.exploratory_scale: Prompt-policy effects differ between E2B and the earlier exploratory E4B experiment.

selection.screening: Run every arm on all examples with index < 50.
selection.universal_winner: Maximize validation exact matches; break ties by lower mean completion tokens, then manifest order.
selection.router: For each task and candidate arm, fit Beta(wins+1, losses+1) on paired calibration discordances against direct_answer. Route only when net wins and posterior superiority pass a validation-selected conservative gate.
selection.router_hyperparameter_selection: Maximize validation exact matches; break ties by lower token use, fewer routed tasks, higher posterior threshold, higher minimum net wins, then fixed grid order.
selection.deduplication: Identical finalist configurations are run once.

outcomes.primary: pooled micro exact-match accuracy across BBH, BBEH, and unpuzzles_and_simple_reasoning test rows

inference.primary_test: exact two-sided McNemar test for router versus direct_answer
inference.secondary_tests: exact two-sided McNemar tests versus direct_answer with Holm family-wise correction
inference.effect_intervals: 10000-replicate task-stratified paired bootstrap, fixed seed 20260709, percentile 95% confidence interval

robustness.full_test_repeats: Repeat direct_answer and the primary router at seeds 20260710 and 20260711.
robustness.model_scale_replication: Compare the confirmatory E2B effects with the already completed exploratory E4B results without reclassifying E4B as confirmatory.

integrity.test_launch_gate: selection.json and its SHA-256 must be written before any index >= 50 request
